newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn bids firmer, soybeans slip.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn bids firmer, soybeans slip.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn bids were a shade firmer in deferred positions on Tuesday while soybean values slipped, exporters said.
"It's just a lack of business," one soybean FOB trader said, referring to the dip in basis levels. "We haven't been doing a whole lot of business and the (CBOT) board helped out a bit."
CBOT soybean futures rallied late to close higher.
In export news, Owensboro Grain Co, a U.S. soybean crusher, confirmed on Tuesday it was negotiating to import more South American soybeans.
The company would not confirm tonnage but other U.S. exporters said the deal involved up to two cargoes.
Owensboro bought three cargoes of soybeans earlier this year. One load came from Brazil and the other two were later switched to U.S. origin.
